```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path("metadata/project_config.yaml"))
```

## Run parameters

All values read directly from `metadata/project_config.yaml`.

```{r params}
flatten_config <- function(x, prefix = "") {
  rows <- list()
  for (nm in names(x)) {
    key <- if (nzchar(prefix)) paste0(prefix, ".", nm) else nm
    val <- x[[nm]]
    if (is.list(val) && !is.null(names(val))) {
      rows <- c(rows, flatten_config(val, key))
    } else {
      rows <- c(rows, list(data.frame(
        Parameter = key,
        Value     = paste(unlist(val), collapse = ", "),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )))
    }
  }
  rows
}

cfg_df <- do.call(rbind, flatten_config(cfg))
knitr::kable(cfg_df, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Chapters

| Chapter | Samples | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Full cohort | Rx_1–8 | All samples processed together |
| Stroma | Rx_1, Rx_2 | Stromal compartment |
| HSC | Rx_3, Rx_4, Rx_5 | Haematopoietic stem cells |
| MNC | Rx_6, Rx_7, Rx_8 | Mononuclear cells |
| HSC + MNC | Rx_3–8 | Combined haematopoietic compartment |

## Pipeline summary

```{r pipeline-summary}
#| results: asis
cat("
**Data loading**: CellRanger output read per sample and merged.

**QC**: Mitochondrial, ribosomal and haemoglobin percentages computed.
Cells filtered on `nFeature_RNA`, `percent.mt`, `percent.rp`, `percent.hb`.

**HTO demultiplexing**: deMULTIplex2 run on raw HTO counts.
Classes removed: **", paste(unlist(cfg$qc$remove_hto_classes), collapse = ", "), "**
(empty = all retained).

**Doublet detection**: scDblFinder run per sample on QC-filtered cells.
Doublets", if (cfg$qc$remove_doublets) "**removed**" else "**retained**", ".

**Processing**: Normalisation (", if (cfg$processing$ref_assay == "SCT") "SCTransform" else "lognorm", ") → HVG selection → PCA →
Harmony batch correction (`batch_factor =", cfg$processing$batch_factor, "`) →
SNN graph → Leiden clustering → UMAP.

**Markers**: FindAllMarkers (Wilcoxon, presto) on res 0.3 clusters.
")
```
